hero.title: Hello! I am Libní González
intro: , with professional experience since 2022 and specialized training in the study of the mind, behavior and brain functioning. I hold a
Master's in Neuroscience Applied to Psychology

, along with additional training in Neuropsychology. My background allows me to integrate the psychological perspective with knowledge from neuroscience to better understand how we think, feel, learn and relate to others.
My work is grounded in a

, adapting each process to the person's needs and goals. For me, psychological care is not only about addressing a difficulty, but also about understanding it, developing tools and fostering changes that can be applied to everyday life.
My goal is to offer a professional, respectful and welcoming space, where each person can better understand what they are experiencing and develop resources to cope with it in a healthy way.

services.title: Services
subtitle: As a
Clinical Psychologist
I offer professional support to people looking to improve their emotional well-being and face different challenges in their lives.
All my sessions are held online
, allowing greater comfort, flexibility, and accessibility for my patients.
method: A safe and confidential space to work on emotions, thoughts, and behaviors affecting your well-being.
Techniques and strategies to manage worries, tension, and anxiety symptoms.
Learning practical tools for emotional and mental balance.

sessions.title: Sessions
body: Each session is unique, just like you.

My approach is fully personalized and focused on supporting you in achieving the goals you seek in therapy. I work with scientifically supported tools, integrating a multidisciplinary approach with cognitive-behavioral, neuropsychological, and humanistic foundations. Throughout the process, we will build a therapeutic plan together that lets us move step by step toward the goals set in the sessions.

about.title: About me
body: I consider myself a curious person, with a constant interest in learning, discovering and understanding how things work. I enjoy exploring different areas of knowledge and finding connections between them, especially between

Science has been an important part of my education and of the way I understand the world, while art allows me to approach it from a different, more creative and human perspective. That is why I enjoy getting involved in activities that let me learn, experience and combine both forms of expression.
In psychology, my main interest has always been

, seeking to understand the processes that influence how we think, feel and act. This is also what has led me to take a deep interest in neuroscience and in a psychological practice grounded in scientific knowledge.
For me, continuing to learn is not only part of my profession, but also a way to grow personally and to keep alive my curiosity for understanding what I do not yet know.
